publisher: U.S. Environmental Protection Agency, AirData (Air Quality System)
documentation_phrases: Number of days in the year having an Air Quality Index value.
This is the number of days on which measurements from any monitoring site in the county or MSA were reported to the AQS database.
Number of days in the year having an AQI value 0 through 50.
The highest daily AQI value in the year.
90 percent of daily AQI values during the year were less than or equal to the 90th percentile value.
Half of daily AQI values during the year were less than or equal to the median value, and half equaled or exceeded it.
Data for the current year are considered preliminary until May 1 of the following year.
many areas have monitoring stations for some, but not all, of the pollutants.
identifier_rule: GEOID = EPA AQS State Code + County Code, taken from the AirData site listing row whose exact State Name and County Name equal the annual file's State and County. Each pair must resolve to one code. The TIGER 2024 name for that GEOID must then agree under the documented name rules or be a reviewed variant below.

measures.label: Median AQI
measures.population: days with a reported daily AQI from county monitoring sites
measures.official_definition: Half of daily AQI values during the year were less than or equal to the median value, and half equaled or exceeded it.
measures.statistic_note: Median of the county's daily AQI values; a distribution statistic, not an uncertainty interval.

measures.label: 90th percentile AQI
measures.population: days with a reported daily AQI from county monitoring sites
measures.official_definition: 90 percent of daily AQI values during the year were less than or equal to the 90th percentile value.
measures.statistic_note: 90th percentile of the county's daily AQI values; a distribution statistic, not a confidence interval or margin of error.

measures.label: Maximum AQI
measures.population: days with a reported daily AQI from county monitoring sites
measures.official_definition: The highest daily AQI value in the year.
measures.statistic_note: Highest single daily AQI value. Values above 500 are beyond the AQI scale and are shown as published.

measures.label: Days with AQI
measures.population: calendar days in 2025 with a reported daily AQI from county monitoring sites
measures.official_definition: Number of days in the year having an Air Quality Index value. This is the number of days on which measurements from any monitoring site in the county or MSA were reported to the AQS database.
measures.statistic_note: Reporting-day count; varies by county and is not annualized.

measures.label: Good days
measures.population: days with a reported daily AQI from county monitoring sites
measures.official_definition: Number of days in the year having an AQI value 0 through 50.
measures.statistic_note: Count of reporting days with AQI 0–50. Interpret with Days with AQI; not a percentage and not annualized.
